style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, rose pink #F2A7B3 and pink gradient #E96A7E-#F4A9B6 for benefit and closing screens, washed blue wood #7FB3C8 for the lifestyle scene

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh juicy fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft rose pink #F2A7B3, deep rose accent #D4334E and dark rose text #7E2733; warm tone; soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle top key and soft contact shadows, fresh glistening moisture on the fruit skin without plastic sheen; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep rose #7E2733 or white #FFFFFF, headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent thin-line circle icons and rounded pill labels; clean fresh-produce photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the fruit across the set; cut halves always show the pale flesh toward camera; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout
